name: deny_code
description: Machine-readable denial vocabulary for the platform API: why a policy gate (preflight, submit) refused an action, so consumers fail fast and route on the reason without parsing prose. Carried by the typed errors in-process and by the problem+json envelope's code and issues[].code over HTTP.

definitions.subject_unknown: The subject does not exist or is not onboarded.
definitions.role_denied: The caller's role may not run this stage.
definitions.ordering_violated: A prior stage's record does not exist for this subject.
definitions.budget_exhausted: The spend budget for this subject and stage is exhausted.
definitions.config_stale: The config generation the caller holds is not current.
definitions.countersign_required: The ledger submit gate requires a countersignature.
definitions.review_required: The ledger submit gate requires human review.

note: API vocabulary, not a JSON Schema enum site. The submit path re-verifies every preflight denial, so no code is preflight-only.
